# Formblatt

Formblatt is a browser-based PDF editor for creating fillable forms and AcroForms. It runs in the browser using PDF.js and PDF-Lib, without sending files or form data to external servers.

## Links

- Production: https://formblatt.dpdns.org
- Source Code: https://github.com/sshrestha-design/formblatt
- Full Context: https://formblatt.dpdns.org/llms-full.txt
- License: MIT

## Core Features

- Document Processing: PDF.js renders pages to canvas. PDF-Lib generates and modifies AcroForms directly in browser memory.
- Formula and Calculation Engine: Evaluates sums, products, tax, and discount recipes with live previews. Exports ISO-compliant AcroForm /AA calculate scripts and /CO calculation order arrays.
- Field Detection: Scans pages using 2D geometric vector analysis, OCR contour extraction, and local ONNX neural models to locate form lines, boxes, and checkboxes.
- Field Types: Text fields, comb character boxes, static text labels, dropdown menus, checkboxes, radio groups, and signature widgets.
- Digital Signatures: Freehand canvas drawing, cursive font rendering, and image signature stamps.
- Canvas Tools: Alignment guides, magnetic snapping, multi-field selection, drag duplication, and undo history.
- PDF Flattening: Exports both interactive AcroForms and flattened read-only PDFs with burned-in vector content.
- Data Export and Import: Reads and writes form values to CSV and JSON formats.
- Offline Support: Service Worker caches all assets for offline use.

## File Structure

- index.html: Single-page application shell.
- styles/: Modular CSS stylesheets (base, editor, canvas, landing, modals).
- js/core/: Application state, formula evaluation, constants, undo/redo history, and CSV/JSON data export.
- js/engines/: PDF rendering (pdf-engine), AcroForm compiler (acroform-builder), geometric field detector (auto-detector), ONNX vision detector, and OCR engine.
- js/controllers/: Editor workspace controller and landing page manager.
- js/ui/: Canvas viewport, overlay managers, properties inspector, layers panel, command palette, and signature pad.
- js/utils/: Toast notifications, tooltips, and haptic feedback.
- tests/: 154-test automated regression suite, speed benchmarks, and detector evaluation tools.
